a)
While calculating GNP, income generated by nationals of a country residing outside
the country is not taken into account.
b)
The value of national income adjusted for inflation is called as ‘real national income’.
c)
The income of the individuals at their disposal after paying direct taxes like income
tax is called ‘real income’.
